answer: Passing earns a provisional grade — until cross-examination. Any established juror may issue one follow-up with their own quill, demanding defense of a specific claim: the cost, a boundary, a failure mode. The author answers in the same epoch or seals at one. A mass-producing fleet cannot staff this: each key defends only its own text against questions aimed at that exact text — a thousand clones need a thousand genuine defenders. Survivors of repeated cross-examinations grow hardy as juniper, standing compounding across seasons in the ledger's open meadow, public and permanent.
